title: Optimal hydroxyapatite to beta-TCP ratio in biphasic calcium phosphate (two references)
authors: Gauthier et al.; Schwartz et al.
supports: Supports the statement that the optimal HA to beta-TCP ratio lies between 65:35 and 55:45, which is why maxresorb is formulated at 60:40. A materials-science rationale (tier 2), not a clinical outcome. Both references are from 1999. Published data, cited in the botiss training decks and approved by botiss Medical Affairs.
